transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I assert that the integrity, security, and privacy of attendance data are paramount. TRU-01 ensures encryption of data at rest and in transit, safeguarding against unauthorized access. TRU-02 implements role-based access control to restrict access according to user roles, enhancing security. TRU-03 maintains an audit log for modifications, promoting accountability. TRU-04 requires authentication for students to view their records, ensuring privacy. TRU-05 employs checksums for data integrity verification, while TRU-06 provides a reporting mechanism for data breaches. Finally, TRU-07 enforces session timeouts to protect against inactivity risks. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy attendance tracking system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure user authentication and role-based access control to protect attendance data.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to maintain data accuracy.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall provide real-time attendance updates while ensuring energy-efficient processing methods.
The system shall generate attendance reports within specified timeframes while minimizing digital resource usage.
The system shall enable students to view their attendance records with a response time under 3 seconds.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms for data processing to minimize energy consumption.
